Kareem Store - Windows Desktop App
==================================

How to run on another PC:
1. Extract this entire folder to any location (e.g. Desktop\KareemStore).
2. Double-click: abo_magdy.exe
3. Keep all files in this folder together. Do not move only the .exe.

Requirements:
- Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Internet connection (Firebase)
- If the app does not start, install Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
  https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

Notes:
- Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run because the app is not signed.
  Click "More info" then "Run anyway" if needed.
- Bluetooth printing features require Bluetooth on the target PC.
